subject: Final go/no-go timing and activation ramp for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@acmeretail.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + evaluation plan for go/no-go timing

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is the mutual action plan (v2) and the evaluation plan we discussed. Key dates are called out in the MAP but to summarize:

- Evaluation window: Aug 2–Aug 20 (3 weeks of active testing)
- Final review and legal signoff: Aug 23–Aug 27
- Target activation (start date): Sep 1

From our side I want to make sure we lock down two things by Aug 9: (1) procurement's redline timeline and contact for contract negotiation; (2) an internal exec-level go/no-go checkpoint (we typically run that as a one-hour decision meeting).

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB) | Acme_SOW_2027.docx (DOCX, 120KB)

Open items for you: please confirm procurement contact and whether there are any additional compliance docs we should surface early (SOC2, data retention policy).

If it helps I can propose a short internal cadence for approvals and signoff windows — aiming to avoid a last-minute push on the 27th.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[t] +1 415-555-0112
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@acmeretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@acmeretail.com>, Acme Retail Procurement <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation plan for go/no-go timing

Tessa — thanks for sending. Reviewing the MAP now. A couple quick notes:

- Procurement contact is procurement@acmeretail.com (cc'd). Ben will own the contract side but procurement should handle the redlines.
- We need the SOC2 and the retention policy — our InfoSec team will want them before mid-August.
- For the evaluation window, can we shift one week later (Aug 9–Aug 27)? We have a feature freeze on the 30th and prefer to avoid overlap.

I'll confirm internally and get back with a concrete signoff timeline by Aug 3.

Best,
Lisa
Director, Data & AI
Acme Retail
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 10:22:45 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + evaluation plan for go/no-go timing

Tessa / Dev —

FYI — Lisa suggested moving the evaluation window out a week. That's fine operationally but has a knock-on effect for our legal & procurement timeline. If Acme runs Aug 9–27, legal review would need to start no later than Aug 23 to keep the Sep 1 start.

Questions for planning:
- Do we have the SOC2 and retention policy packaged to send by EOD 3 Aug? (InfoSec asked for it)
- Who is leading the internal go/no-go meeting on our side? I can schedule it but need name and invite list.

Proposed internal timeline (high level):
- Aug 3: send SOC2 + retention docs to Acme InfoSec (if available)
- Aug 9: evaluation starts (tentative)
- Aug 26: internal exec decision meeting (to allow 1 day for DocuSign)

I can own scheduling and make sure Legal has the redlines as soon as procurement returns them.

-Laura
VP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Acme Retail Procurement <procurement@acmeretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:37:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract redlines and cadence

Team —

Attached is our initial redline (Contract_Redline_Acme_v3.pdf). High level: key asks are around data residency and SLA credits. We can move quickly on language but need 3 full business days to route internally for our signers after a final redline.

Proposed cadence from Acme:
- Aug 3–Aug 9: Redwood responds with updated contract or counter-marked doc
- Aug 10–Aug 20: Acme legal and procurement review (concurrent with evaluation)
- Aug 23–Aug 27: Final signers available to execute (DocuSign window)

We will also accept a conditional start where a redacted SOW is signed first and the full contract follows within 30 days.

Attaching the redline: Contract_Redline_Acme_v3.pdf (PDF, 230KB)

Thanks,
Acme Retail Procurement
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: proposed go/no-go decision — Acme Retail (target Sep 1 start)

Team —

Quick alignment note so we can give Acme a clear answer by Aug 9. Summary of current state:
- Acme proposes evaluation Aug 9–Aug 27 (moved one week)
- Procurement sent redlines; they need ~3 business days to route after our counter
- Acme confirmed DocuSign availability Aug 23–27

I propose the following internal decision approach:
1) Tech/Eng evaluation OK (Dev) — functional signoff by Aug 19
2) InfoSec docs provided by Aug 3 (Rachel to confirm)
3) Legal & Commercial: counter redline returned by Aug 6, final internal signoff Aug 25
4) Exec go/no-go meeting: Aug 26, 10:00–10:45 PT — decision to allow DocuSign window Aug 27–Aug 29 for any last minute routing

If anyone cannot make the Aug 26 exec meeting, please confirm your approval via email thread no later than Aug 25 EOD. This is the pivotal gating item for the Sep 1 activation.

Attachments: (see thread)

Thanks — I can send a calendar invite once we reconfirm slots.

—Tessa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: proposed go/no-go decision — Acme Retail (target Sep 1 start)

Folks —

I've reviewed the MAP and contract redline. Rachel, if InfoSec can confirm SOC2 + retention docs were sent to Acme on Aug 3, I am comfortable giving conditional exec signoff now:

- Executive conditional signoff: YES
- Condition: final contract counter returned by Aug 6 and DocuSign executed during Aug 23–27 window (or SOW-signed + full contract within 30 days)
- Target start date: Sep 1 — please confirm readiness of onboarding team and billing setup.

Laura/Rachel/Tessa — please confirm and I'll take the signoff to the exec meeting on Aug 26.

—Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
